subject: maths
question: A certain sum amounts to ₹17,925 in 3 years and to ₹21,825 in 7 years at the same rate per cent per annum at simple interest. What will be the simple interest (in ₹) on a sum of ₹18,500 for 4 {2 over 5} years at double the earlier rate?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount in 3 year = ₹17,925

Amount in 7 year = ₹21,825

**Formula used:**

**1**. SI = (PRT)/100

**2**. Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time(in years)

**Calculation:**

SI in (7 - 3) year = 21825 - 17925

⇒ SI in 4 year = ₹3900

⇒ SI in 3 year = 3900 x 3/4 = ₹2925

Now, P = 17925 - 2925 = ₹15000

⇒ 2925 = (15000 × 3 × R)/100

⇒ R = 6.5%

⇒ 2R = 13%

According to the question,

SI = (18500 x 22 x 13)/(5 x 100)

⇒ SI = ₹10,582

**∴ The required SI is ₹10,582.**
